notes.title: Shared quests

[h3]Version 1.094[/h3]

notes.title: Warped Continuum Events Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Warped Continuum Events[/h2]
The Warped Continuum Event is a new kind of end-game procedural challenge that gets more difficult the further you progress. They are all large enough to accomodate the biggest ships (although some ships modded with the "Big" mod still will require some maneuverability skills :)).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/264d6c49e30e274ee5ae673b1660ddc64afb8990.gif[/img]

As the difficulty of these events for the most part is linearly increased based on how far you progress, there should not be any huge difficulty spikes (such as the difficulty gaps between the Minor, Grand, and Uber Continuum Events). 

The Warped Continuum Event loot table differs from regular Continuum Events. In particular, they have a higher likelihood of dropping items that add bonus skill points. They are also the only way to gain [i]In-S Fragments[/i], which add bonus skill points to items (you previously had to find an item with bonus skill points and extract the skills through an Ext-S Fragment). The quality of these items depend on the difficulty of the Warped Continuum Event. The more difficult events have a chance to drop Uber-tier items. 

They start to drop in the Continuum difficulty. You can also craft them using the [i]Random Warped Contained Continuum Event recipe[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e94c870bacb606e23b53006d13b96cf705856b75.png[/img]

There is a high-score system in place for these Warped Continuum Events. The difficulty of dropped Warped Continuum Events depend on this high-score. There is also a Continuum Transmuter recipe to reduce the difficulty of a Warped Continuum Event (see [i]Downgrade Warped Continuum Event[/i]).

[h2]Infinite Warped Continuum Events[/h2]
I wont say much about these events, apart from that they only drop in Warped Continuum Events...

[h2]Major overhaul to the English localization[/h2]
The English localization has received a complete overhaul, with more than 3000 words having been revised and many entries added! This was done single handedly by [i]Morgan Walter[/i] (@syovere on Discord). Many thanks for your hard work!

[h2]Customize your Uber rewards[/h2]
You can now set an item that is desired as reward for completing a given Uber Continuum Event. See the recipe "[i]Set Uber Continuum Event Reward[/i]". The idea is to make it easier to farm specific items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/dcd6debaad549a6f3f3726f83da2f34a56131e65.gif[/img]

[h2]Imperius enemies[/h2]
You can now encounter Imperius enemies! A total of 16 new Imperius enemies have been added. You can presently encounter these in the Warped Continuum Events.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/56d8598031e41c4bf673ff63bc77ef7355890fa3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3a93cb5209b825fae04db936425c9412b18eb5ac.gif[/img]

[h2]New items![/h2]
🎯 Two new hangars that summon Imperius fighters have been added to the loot table.
🎯 A new hangar that summon Imperius cruisers has been added to the loot table.
🎯 A new Imperius fighter-class ship has been added to the loot table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/072aee6784c13c44952c3826f942ea67890e8791.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/d93c06e556caa95bebb283bbe347ed9324edbc22.png[/img]

[h2]Performance in caves[/h2]
I have read your feedback on the performance issues in caves (especially in Act 2). 

This patch provides overall performance improvements to caves. Additionally, you can now also opt to render cave walls at a lower resolution (see the image below). This provides greatly increased performance at the cost of a minor (often negligible) reduction in the image quality of cave walls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/fd5e0392ee1e3e4266dec8518095f7f5957cc1ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e39c0b252e73f7b439a9064e300f75bcf5ce2ed2.png[/img]

[h2]Misc changes[/h2]
🎯 Many enemy death animations have been polished.
🎯 The Continuum Transmuter UI has received a minor update.
🎯 The names of some world events have been changed.
🎯 A menu battle scene featuring Imperius vs Axiom has been added.
🎯 The final boss in Act 4 no longer summons any turrets. 
🎯 Loot has been improved for the final boss in Act 4. 
🎯 The "Recommended level" for Continuum Events has been revised.
🎯 Better profiling of hardware info (GPU and available RAM) to reduce the effort required to debug related errors. 
🎯 The warp gate button has been moved (see below image).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/52ac111f9beca6d602a905017feb8b93888c79aa.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
🎯 Fixed an issue that could cause an infinite loading screen when disconnecting from a PvP or fleet commander game while a map switch was being made.
🎯 Fixed multiple localization issues.
🎯 Replaced an incorrect portrait (the second boss in Act 4).
🎯 Fixed an item duplication bug related to Continuum Events.
🎯 Fixed an issue that could cause caves/asteroids to not render correctly if playing with a shadow quality of medium or lower.
🎯 Fixed an issue that could cause the map to fail to update correctly when some kinds of entities with map animations were destroyed (e.g., some rocks and walls).

[h3]Thanks for your support - I hope you enjoy the new content![/h3]

[h3]/Hannes[/h3]

notes.title: Official support for Catalan! Also updates to tooltips and buffs to skills.
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.074[/h3] 
🎯 [Catalan] The entire game now officially supports Catalan! This work was made by the Ce Trencada Project, that translates video games into Catalan completely free of charge with the sole objective of promoting the culture of video games in Catalan.
🎯 [Item tooltips] You can now view the complete tooltip of an item without comparing it to other equipped items. 
🎯 [Balance] World boss encounters have been revised: a much bigger portion of the damage to a segment is applied to the head. This effectively means that segments will stay alive for a longer period of time.
🎯 [Balance] The item set "Pocket Deathmachine" has been buffed and its buffs/debuffs are now 2x as potent.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders T4 skill "Tiny But Deadly" has been buffed. It now provides 8% buff per level (up from 4%).
🎯 [Balance] The Xinthu T3 skill "Crushing Hits" has been buffed. It now provides a 30% bonus in crit damage (up from 20%).
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T2 skill "Frostbite" has been buffed. It now provides 10% more damage per level (up from 6%).
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T3 skill "Blazing rockets" has been buffed. It now provides 4% bonus attack speed per level (up from 2%). This means that it now provides 40% bonus attack speed to fixed-points weapons at max level (5 points).
🎯 [Balance] The Founders T7 skill "Skill Shot" has been buffed when using fighter-class ships. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with item tooltips that could cause a gap in the top border for some items tooltips in combination with certain font scales.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed several format string issues related to texts in Japanese, German, Portugese, Swedish and Russian.

notes.title: Random Uber Continuum Event recipe + much more!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.073[/h3]
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter recipe] A new recipe has been added: "Random Uber Continuum Event". 
🎯 [Balance] The ship resistance mod now provides increased resistance to all elements (previously all but ballistic). This change will only affect ships that are modded post this patch.
🎯 [Balance] The drop-rate of Uber Contained Continuum Events has been increased.
🎯 [Balance] The weight of many kinds of player summons has been reduced. This should make the issue of summons pushing enemies around much less problematic.
🎯 [Performance] Minor performance improvements when using the item highlight filter by moving some calculations to a background thread.
🎯 [Misc] Worm sound effects for movement and attacking have been revised.
🎯 [Misc] You can now disable the file integrity checks made by clients when connecting to a COOP campaign game. To do so, set the value of 'Networking_RequireMatchingHashsum' to 'false' in the config.cfg file. This is safe from a server perspective: if files differ, it will at worst cause weird/unknown behaviour for the client. This addition was made as some older operating systems (e.g., some versions of Windows 7) produce inconsistent MD5 for game data/files. If any magician know why this is the case, please let me know!
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that on very rare occasions could cause the item highlight filter to incorrectly include/exclude items. This could occur if the parameters of the item highlight filter were being changed simultaneous to an item being processed by the item filter. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed errors in the tooltips for the skills "Intense Repairs" and "Warp Plasma Converter".

notes.title: Create your own experiences using the game editor!
notes.content:
[h2]Merry christmas and a happy new year![/h2]
Today's patch (1.06) brings two new major features: a game editor and the Dungeon Master mode!

[h2]Editor[/h2]
The editor enables creating custom experiences and can be started through a button in the game, or alternatively, by running the executable "NienixEditor.exe" (Windows) or "NienixEditor" (Linux/MacOS) from the game directory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/2dc4792b0e37a70eb821a31375438b9cf4b122b3.png[/img]

Create custom campaigns with your own rules and mechanics! You can, for example, add different triggers and outcomes (e.g., "destroy an enemy X opens a door Y"), write your own quests, specify your own rewards, and add map modifiers similar to those in Continuum Events. What other features that I add depend mostly on what you want to be able to do - please give me your suggestions!

The editor is integrated with the Steam workshop, which should make it easy for you to share the experiences that you create with others. There is a guide to the editor available here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3110920722

I have also uploaded an example mod that provide basic information about different features here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3097417872

Modded games uses a separate character sheet that ensures that progress is separated between mods and the campaign. You can clone any character in the campaign for the purpose of playing modded games.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b9e070137b16e5cff634f4a66e2380bc3d155590.png[/img]

Last, but not least: [b]You gain a Steam achievement when you contribute with your first public mod to the community![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/8b8f029ac8d439b2b15bd94493f6c397fbca0b16.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3ba0b79d023681549d41ff218d81985a38fdceee.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/2c1212f3396e00802cc9c90adbdc5a858e04a575.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/eb6472abd69c10d21ad62b562aa58b50d417f08c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e719ffc9ba0032c75e88df68c910aaf3f1f46bd3.gif[/img]

[h2]Dungeon Master[/h2]
Apart from the game editor, I am also excited to announce that a new game mode called Dungeon Master (DM) has been added! In this game mode, the hosting player acts as a dungeon master, and can manipulate the world to create custom challenges. 

Acting as a DM is probably an especially fun experience if you do it for a mod that you have created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/d66258cf66a116cb26282bdcd404f23604d39fe5.png[/img]

The DM has a few important things that should be mentioned:

[list]
[*]The DM can summon most enemies that have been defeated during the campaign. A few kinds of enemies are currently not supported.
[*]The DM inherits the base progress of the selected character.
[*]The DM can teleport by double-clicking a location in the map.
[*]The DM can not open loot containers or pick up items from world-space. The DM can, however, interact with the storage as well as drop items in world-space.
[*]Chat messages sent by the DM are presented as quest dialogues for the participating players.
[*]Progress made by client players in DM games is separated from the standard campaign.
[*]Progress is only saved for regular players (i.e., not for the DM).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/6140c7ef6d440cd9ea3322ac200c6e6112b732b0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/d97b571abbf8633eaf6b0f264bda66c76e5b6576.gif[/img]

Have fun! Im looking forward to trying out all your creations! ːsteamthisːːsteamthisːːsteamthisː

/Hannes

🎯 [Multiplayer] You can now disable the default Master Server client-server introduction process for your private Internet games (e.g., those you have added by pressing "favorite" on a public game).
🎯 [Multiplayer] Slightly improved (= reduced) bandwidth for servers.
🎯 [Multiplayer] It is now possible to adjust the network throughput of both server and client through three new variables in the config.cfg-file:
* Networking_MaxUnreliableEntitiesToSendDuringFrame (default: 15; lower means less data to send for the server)
* Networking_MaxUnreliablePacketsPerFrame (default: 5; lower means less data to send for the server)
* Networking_WorldSynchDelay (default: 1; higher means less data to send for both server and client)

Note that if you change these values too much from default, you will end up with weird behavior such as teleporting and rubber-banding for enemies and bullets.

notes.title: Fleet Commander Update!
notes.content:
It's now been half a year since Nienix reached 1.0!

To celebrate, today's patch (1.050) includes a completely new game mode called [b]Fleet Commander[/b]. Apart from this game mode, a whole bunch of other content has been added during the past three months (the time since the last major news update). This post highlights significant changes. As always, follow the patch notes for the complete list.

[h2]Fleet Commander[/h2]
This game mode was inspired by Gratuitous Space Battles and allows you to orchestrate large-scale fleet battles. Play against an AI in the offline mode or a friend through the online modes.

You can only summon foes that you have defeated during the campaign. I hope this feature makes exploring random events more rewarding, as these include enemies that you would not face by solely following the main quest line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a29f0a0a08303a558b7ad185429b4667bd00b6f4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a9f5ded432c62c7faacf808da9e333dee8709786.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c1ebf60ce3f89a0fc34726114ea386ea4a598ee7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a474d312f44ba978e9836f6300cfa4e3e3ce8a6d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/9404349629716597c15d4e5f644c12b514386b15.gif[/img]

[h2]Updates to the Continuum Transmuter[/h2]
I know that many of you have a love/hate relationship with the Continuum Transmuter. It is useful to roll and alter gear, but the process takes a long time - especially during the end-game. Thats why the Continuum Transmuter has been revised. In particular, it now includes the storage. The auto-match-recipes takes the items in the storage into consideration.

Recipe auto-matching also better considers item grades when evaluating what to upgrade. Mythic- and Uber-grade items are no longer automatically selected. The latter was done to ensure that no important end-game items could be transmuted through the auto-matching feature by mistake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f2645bfd0ad9e88bb6e341873bddd4b27e7e7177.png[/img]

[h2]Items can now unlock different skills[/h2]
Legendary+ tier engines and ships can now roll with unlockable skills (up to tier 5)! Some skills only roll for certain kinds of ships/engines. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/084965112c31b03462ef96cad7b58fa8b43eb9f9.png[/img]

[h2]The core game engine has been updated[/h2]
The core game code has been updated to .NET 6.0. This brings many improvements. In particular, newer Linux platforms such as Ubuntu 22 are now supported "out of the box" (there is no longer a need to add older libraries required by the previous game version on such platforms).

[h2]Updates for controller players[/h2]
A new (gamepad-only) radial menu has been added that enables more easily enabling/disabling game screens that previously required two hotkeys pressed in combination (e.g., the inventory or map). The previous keybindings remain as-was; the radial menu is only enabled if the start-button is clicked (rather than pressed). Radial menus now also behave more closely to the variant used in Diablo 3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c38e64e2b2637ec23042851b58b5ce114db1cc48.png[/img]

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 [New ship] A new Dreadnought-class ship has been added to the loot table. The default variant of this ship is narrow and 1100m long.
🎯 [Continuum Entity] Ext-S Fragment: Extracts all skill bonuses from an item and stores them in a Continuum Entity. The item is destroyed in the process.
🎯 [Continuum Entity] In-S Fragment: Inserts the skill bonuses in the In-S Fragment to a desired ship or engine. Any existing skill bonuses in that item are replaced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e3e90d788af564e162a1452d2f6b368e536f97ac.gif[/img]

[h2]Catalan[/h2]
The entire game now officially supports Catalan (albeit some polish still remain - the final version is expected to be completed within a few weeks)! This work was made by the Ce Trencada Project, that translates video games into Catalan completely free of charge, altruistically, and with a purely cultural purpose, with the sole objective of promoting the culture of video games in Catalan. 

I deeply appreciate your contribution!

[h2]Japanese, German, Portugese, French, Spanish and Swedish[/h2]
Based on player requests, I've decided to include the machine-made translations for Japanese, German, Portugese, Spanish, French and Swedish in the main branch. These localizations are bound to contain many errors. Please report incorrect texts on Steam or [url=https://discord.com/invite/EADHvjX]Discord[/url]! Or download the localization spreadsheet and correct it yourself. Translation instructions can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1332760/discussions/0/5501743491370003221/]here[/url].

I've decided not to tag the Steam store page with these machine-made translations - only localizations made manually (or at least thoroughly proof-read) are visible on Steam. Additionally, the machine-made translations are highlighted with a red color in the language selection drop-down menu and have a warning text popup.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e139304eb4c4f81adbfd87c3f0f46312dc5f8495.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
🎯 [Misc] Engine auto-boost and active auxiliary auto-use are now coupled to the two ship hull configs.
🎯 [Misc] Fixed-point weapon auto-fire is now coupled to the two weapon configs.
🎯 [Keybindings] You can now bind all toggles in the radial menu (toggle the active skill, auto-fire weapons, auto-use auxiliary items and auto-boost engine) to keyboard/mouse keys. These options are available under Options -> Auto-use controls.
🎯 [Balance] There has been a plethora of balance changes. In particular, many skills have been buffed and various enemies have been rebalanced. Summoned drones also have lower penalties to resistances during end-game Continuum Events.
🎯 [UI] There is now information regarding the connection status to the master server in the public server listing.
🎯 [UI] The local player map icon is now presented in the transparent map.

[h2]So, what's next?[/h2]
I am currently working on some really cool stuff that have been suggested by many of you. Please keep giving me your awesome suggestions! I promise, I read them all (even if it sometimes takes me a long time to answer). It really makes the dev process a whole lot more fun.

/Hannes

notes.title: Updates to the core game engine
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0442[/h3]
🎯 [Misc] The core game code has been updated to .NET 6.0. This brings many improvements. In particular, newer Linux platforms such as Ubuntu 22 are now supported "out of the box" (there is no longer a need to add older libraries required by the previous game version on such platforms).
🎯 [Misc] If all equipped weapons have 0 DPS, then summoned Cloner-type drones now auto-fire their equipped weapons even if no enemies are near.
🎯 [Misc] The members of the "Founders Boss Trio" now have individual map animations.
🎯 [Bug fix] All item filter text search fields (regex) now work as expected for unidentified items. For example, the item highlighter, loot filter and storage filters. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with "Founders Boss Trio" that could cause homing-type bullets to circle in the boss room. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with "Founders Boss Trio" that could cause the teleporting boss to disappear.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a UI issue that could cause incorrect uncapped values in the character information screen to be shown.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause soft-caps to be incorrectly applied.

notes.title: New Continuum Transmuter UI that includes the Storage! Also: Ship turret buffs
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0437 - 1.0438[/h3]
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter] The Continuum Transmuter has been revised. In particular, it now includes the storage. The auto-match-recipes also takes the items in the storage into consideration. 
🎯 [UI] The default inventory slot frame for Mythical-grade items has been revised to make it stand out more from Artifact-grade items.
🎯 [Misc] Added a few special keys to the on-screen keyboard.
🎯 [Misc] Player interaction apart from movement has been disabled when in menus (movement is allowed to enable dodging incoming bullets while, for example, browsing the inventory). Additionally, player interaction is completely disabled when using gamepad and a radial menu is active.

🎯 [Balance] Enemy damage has been slightly reduced in Act 1 if playing on the standard campaign.
🎯 [Balance] All individual weapon damage buffs from augments now affect the on-board ship turret that the weapon is equipped on.
🎯 [Balance] Continuum Event resistance reduction modifiers now affect player-summoned drones 50% less.
🎯 [Bug fix] The text popups that are displayed for new items that previously have not dropped for a character are no longer shown for items that are locked by other players due to loot instancing rules.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused incorrect linebreaks in some popups.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a few incorrectly translated texts.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the mod-type fragments that could cause erroneous transmutes given some combinations.

notes.title: Three month update!
notes.content:
It's now been three months since Nienix reached 1.0!

I am so happy to see so many people playing and enjoying the game! The months past the release (especially the first week) have been intense, but reading your feedback and watching you play really makes it all worth the effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/9e1a4ed5cc30f05c5f96924c5514c4217bff2192.gif[/img]

[h2]So, what is new since 1.0?[/h2]
There have been 54 patches deployed since 1.0, and significant new features are presented next. The full patch notes, that includes various other added features, bug fixes and balance changes, are available in the community pages as well as on [url=https://discord.gg/EADHvjX]Discord[/url].  

[h2]Continuum XXL and World Bosses[/h2]
A campaign mode above Continuum XL has been added. It is unlocked upon completing the game on Continuum XL. Among other things, Continuum XXL includes five unique world bosses. These are rare and extremely powerful end-game enemies that provide Uber-tier loot when defeated. Each boss has a custom loot table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/352b601bb01c4eb3f2ed19ad228de640ea7c6255.png[/img]

[h2]A second skill tree[/h2]
A second skill tree has been added! You can toggle the activate tree at any time outside of combat (or even during combat, if you have allocated points in the Axiom skill Quick-Swap!). The two skill trees are tied to the two ship hull configurations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c03b56eb72fd26b7ef2fb38c65286a6552f1a5fa.gif[/img]

[h2]Encyclopedia[/h2]
The encylopedia contains information about all in-game items and item modifications. You can check which items that support what mods, which effects they provide on different items, as well as read their descriptions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b7377ba20587ca77b2ff14298af3f7c81885465d.png[/img]

[h2]Loot filter[/h2]
A new loot filter has been added! Access it from the inventory (next to the encyclopedia). This new filter is separated for each character. In addition to specifying various filters for all kinds of items, it is also possible to override the default colors for different items and grades. Color overriding is done by manually editing the loot filter for the desired character. The lootfilters are XML-files located under <game_root>/Data/Save. For instance, the loot filter for the third character (third row) is named "char2_lootfilter.xml".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/498215b1ea2b1f2a8812966ac9b367612fcf0cb7.gif[/img]

[h2]Instanced loot[/h2]
It is now possible to designate loot as instanced. The following options are available:
🎯 [i]Free for all[/i]: Each loot drop is free for anyone to pick up. (This setting is what was previously available).
🎯 [i]Distance[/i]: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player that is located in the sector. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
🎯 [i]Locked[/i]: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player regardless of where the player is located. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
The variant called "Distance" is the default value. This can be changed in the Loot section of the main menu options. Item locks are removed once the item has been picked up.

[h2]Continuum Transmuter[/h2]
The Continuum Transmuter UI has undergone revisions to make its components more distinguishable. For example, there is now a preview of the outcome of a transmute. Newly unlocked recipes are now also better highlighted in the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b217751baf59d85e4624abfa368a7040792806e7.gif[/img]

[h2]New skills and item sets[/h2]
🎯 [New skill] Tiny but Deadly, a Founders T4 skill has been added: If using a Fighter-class non-Sentinel ship, all fixed-weapon bonuses to attack speed, critical hit chance, critical hit damage and elemental damage are increased by 4 (1 point)- 20% (5 points) of their current amount. At max level, this means that a base buff to attack speed of 200% becomes 240%.
🎯 [New skill] Pocket Pulverizer, a Vagrantis T1 skill has been added: If using a non-Sentinel ship that has a diameter less than {0} metres, fixed-weapon damage is increased by {1}%.
🎯 [Item set] A new item set called "Grandius Obliteratus" has been added. This set is especially useful for those who want their drones to wreak havok.
🎯 [Item set] A new item set called "Pocket Deathmachine" has been added. This set has been designed to make Fighter-class non-Sentinel ships stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/42d241eb633a8cddf639cdfa681d20aba1c34ef4.gif[/img]

[h2]Russian localization[/h2]
All text in the game has been translated to Russian! This work was single-handedly done by @Alekseyzz2078. Many thanks for your help! You can find him on Discord if you have any questions.

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
🎯 [UI] Properties of drone summons (all but proc-type summons) are now shown in much greater detail - especially in the modal/comprehensive tooltip variant.
🎯 [UI] A new bold font has been added - Noto S Bold. This font also supports Chinese and Russian.
🎯 [UI] When an item is compared to another, the icon of the equipped item is now highlighted in the tooltip.
🎯 [UI] An option to disable the white screen-flash has been added. This is located under the General section of the main menu options.

notes.title: New skills, a new item set, and buffs for Fighters!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0423[/h3]
🎯 [New skill] Tiny but Deadly (Founders T4): If using a Fighter-class non-Sentinel ship, all fixed-point weapon bonuses to attack speed, critical hit chance, critical hit damage and elemental damage are increased by 4 (1 point)- 20% (5 points) of their current amount. At max level, this means that a base buff to attack speed of 200% becomes 240%.
🎯 [New skill] Pocket Pulverizer (Vagrantis T1): If using a non-Sentinel ship that has a diameter less than 201 metres, fixed-point weapon damage is increased by 15% (1 point) -30% (2 points).

The bonus to critical damage is {2}% higher if using a Fighter-class non-Sentinel ship.
🎯 [Balance] The "Bad Aim" ship mod has been revised and now works as follows: Ship turrets cannot aim. Damage-dealing weapons are 50% more effective. Auxiliary-type weapons that do not provide damage are 5% more effective.

🎯 [Balance] The Axiom skills "Deadly Aim" and "Aim Mastery" have been buffed.
🎯 [Misc] There previously could occur a delay when picking up items in hectic scenes. This should no longer be the case.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause some weapons on ship turrets to produce an incorrect (too low) damage output.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused incorrect stats to be shown for the Big Mod and Pocket-Sized Mod in the ship tab of the Encyclopedia.

notes.title: Instanced loot and more loot filter options
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0418[/h3]
🎯 [Loot filter] You can now designate item types that always should be enabled in the loot filter, regardless of the other loot filter settings. You can accomplish this by right-clicking an item type in the item view of a loot filter. Always enabled loot will have a green border.
🎯 [Instanced loot] It is now possible to designate loot as instanced. The following options are available:
🎯🎯 Free for all: Each loot drop is free for anyone to pick up. (This setting is what was previously available).
🎯🎯 Distance: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player that is located in the sector. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
🎯🎯 Locked: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player regardless of where the player is located. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
The variant called "Distance" is the default value. This can be changed in the Loot section of the main menu options. Item locks are removed once the item has been picked up.
🎯 [UI] Damage over time values are now prefixed when necessary in item tooltips.
🎯 [Balance] The "auto" difficulty has been reworked as follows:
🎯🎯 1 player: normal 
🎯🎯 2-3 players: hard (previously normal)
🎯🎯 4-5 players: nightmare
🎯🎯 6 players: insane
🎯 [Bug fix] Resetting skills now correctly disables all items that have skill dependencies.
🎯 [Bug fix] Updated some incorrect skill descriptions.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a race condition when evaluating player buffs and debuffs that could cause a crash.

notes.title: A new loot filter!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.040[/h3]
🎯 [Loot filter] A new loot filter has been added! Access it from the inventory (next to the encyclopedia). This new filter is separated for each character and is much more comprehensive than the previous one. In addition to specifying various filters for all kinds of items, it is also possible to override the default colors for different items and grades. Color overriding is done by manually editing the loot filter for the desired character. The lootfilters are XML-files located under <game_root>/Data/Save. For instance, the loot filter for the third character (third row) is named "char2_lootfilter.xml".  
🎯 [Loot pickup options] The loot pickup methods (e.g., bulk pickup) have been moved to the loot filter. You need to re-enable it from this menu.
🎯 [UI] Updated item grade borders to better suit the new coloring options in the loot filter.
🎯 [UI] The option "Bullet effects" (see the Combat section of the main menu options) now apply to most bullet effects and not only explosions. Apart from making things more visible in hectic situations, it should also be useful from a performance standpoint.
🎯 [Balance] Crates/boxes destroyed by your summons can now provide loot.
🎯 [Balance] Changed one of the weapons for the LTM Frigate T-6. This change should also increase performance as the previous weapon required more computation effort.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that prevented binding the radial menu to a keyboard/mouse key.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed faction-related errors related to the three Frost-type Continuum Challenges.
🎯 [Bug fix] The item set "Grand Justice" can no longer roll for ships without turrets.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with wave spawners that could cause enemies to spawn behind walls.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the Corrosive Gatling-type weapon that made it unable to heal summons.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause some waypoints to spawn inside dungeons.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0397[/h3]
🎯 [UI] When playing Continuum and Continuum XL, player and drone resistances pre-reductions are now shown in the character information screen.
🎯 [UI] Enemy portraits are now updated based on damage made by summons. This should improve the experience when playing with pure summoner-builds without any direct player damage.
🎯 [UI] There is now a Neutral option in the storage tab filter to account for non-faction-related items.
🎯 [UI] The hitboxes of the checkboxes in the storage tab filter have been revised.
🎯 [Misc] Previously, the indicator for the currently active quest would switch when moving to other maps to point the player towards the location of the current goal (which then would be through a path of completed goals). This "help" confused many players into thinking the main goal had changed. Thus, this is now not done when moving between different acts.
🎯 [Balance] The area protected by the Deflector Dome now more closely match its hitbox. If a part the ship is outside of the shield, this part can be fired upon.
🎯 [Balance] Consumables and Latinum pickups are now shared across much larger distances. This also solves the previous issue of these not being triggered when using the Bulk loot pickup variant in combination with a high sensor range.
🎯 [Balance] Damage by player summons can now trigger on-hit procs (previously only on-kill procs). This should improve summoner-type builds in end-game.
🎯 [Balance] Auxiliary items can now be used when the attack speed is at -100%.
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T1 skill "Warp Plasma Storage MK1" now provides a % bonus to warp plasma instead of a fixed amount.
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T2 skill "Warp Plasma Storage MK2" has been slightly buffed.
🎯 [Balance] The Axiom T1 skill "Strong Hull" has been slightly nerfed.
🎯 [Balance] Xinthu beam-type weapons no longer collide with friendlies if they are at max hull (i.e., no more collisions with ones own turrets).
🎯 [Balance] All Xinthu-type weapons can now heal friendlies that are not at max hull, and pass through friendlies that are at max hull.
🎯 [Balance] The Xinthu T7 skill "Experimental Catalyst" has been slightly buffed (5% lower reduction to attack speed at level 60).
🎯 [Bug fix] Text of Continuum Entities can now be correctly filtered through the regex filters.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that could cause storage tab regex to be reset when opening/closing the storage screen.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with the To-2 Fragment and the conversion of ship turret buffs to drone buffs.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to several skills that increased warp plasma by a percentage. These did not correctly update the stat sheet % bonus warp plasma statistic.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which caused the Mecha Worm boss in Act 4 to travel far away from its spawn when playing offline/solo campaign.

notes.title: Wave-defense events, UI updates and changes to sensor range!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.850[/h3]
🎯 [Wave events] A completely new kind of event has been added - enemy waves events! Defeat all incoming waves of enemies to obtain a prize.
🎯 [Event] A wave-defense event has been added to Act 1. 
🎯 [Event] A wave-defense event has been added to Act 4. 
🎯 [Map] A new open-world-type map has been added to Act 1. 
🎯 [Map] A new boss map that can be traversed by large ships has been added to Act 1.
🎯 [UI] You can now choose to represent enemies and summons with icons in world space when playing with a really high sensor range. These option are available in Options -> User interface (the drop-down-menus called "Icons for enemies at low zoom" and "Icons for allies at low zoom").
🎯 [UI] World-space zooming is now smoother.
🎯 [UI] Various UI elements, such as item grade borders, have been revised to make them stand out more.
🎯 [UI] The item filter UI components have been revised to make filtered items stand out more.  
🎯 [Balance] Sensor range stacking has been buffed a bit.
🎯 [Balance] Sensor range is now included in all ships (i.e., also fighter-class ships). The range is based on ship level and grade. 
🎯 [Balance] The Founders T7 skill "Skill Shot" has been buffed - it now includes the sensor buff provided by the employed ship in its calculation.
🎯 [Balance] The max number of elite (blue) enemies in a single group has been reduced.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which on rare occasions could lead to bad AI paths.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug that could cause entities at the edges of the screen to be invisible for a short duration when switching from a low sensor range to a high sensor range.
🎯 [Bug fix] Added some missing Chinese texts.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which could cause bad patrol paths to be generated for some enemies.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which could cause really large ships that had equipped the worm hole generator to teleport through walls.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a race condition that could cause a crash.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed incorrect enemy spawn animations for network clients when playing the defend entity events.

notes.title: In-game encyclopedia, major UI updates, new skills and items!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.800[/h3]
🎯 [Encyclopedia] An in-game encyclopedia that contains descriptions of all item types that have been obtained has been added. Access it through the inventory.
🎯 [Skill] The Imperius T3 skill "Glacial Strike" has been added: Frost-based fixed-point weapons are {0}% less effective at freezing enemies. In return, they apply a debuff that decreases Frost resistance by {1}% of the reduced amount.
🎯 [Skill] The Founders T7 skill "Skill Shot" has been buffed.
🎯 [New Continuum Entity] Un Fragment: Upgrades the grade of an item from uncommon to epic.
🎯 [New Continuum Entity] Ep Fragment: Upgrades the grade of an item from epic to artifact.
🎯 [UI] Many/most weapon and auxiliary item sprites have been replaced or updated.
🎯 [UI] Weapon mod descriptions have been revised.
🎯 [UI] There is now a UI indicator whenever an elite enemy dialogue is played that indicate the direction of the enemy. This indicator is only shown if the enemy is outside of camera. It can be disabled by unchecking the "Show hints and tips" checkbox in the general section of the main menu.
🎯 [Misc] Champion+ enemies now have unique summons that depend on their faction.
🎯 [Misc] The "Bulk" loot pickup option now also picks up consumables.
🎯 [Misc] Several maps in the Act 2 are now less dense. 
🎯 [Misc] A specific item class has now been created for sensor-type auxiliary items. Transmuting these items should thus provide more expected results. 
🎯 [Balance] Larger ships and sentinels now have a fixed bonus to sensor range rather than a percentage.
🎯 [Balance] Champion and elite enemies have slightly more hull.
🎯 [Balance] The new damage over time auxiliary items have been buffed. 
🎯 [Balance] Crit chance is no longer capped.
🎯 [Balance] Max bonus attack speed has been increased to 1000% (up from 500%).
🎯 [Balance] The loot recycler has been buffed. It now always gives at least an item two grades above the average that which was recycled (previously one grade).
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the Extract Mod recipe. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a UI issue with the sensor range statistic.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug related to the location of created auras for some kinds of weapons.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug related to one of the Continuum Challenges.

notes.title: End of Early Access: 24th of March 2023!
notes.content:
[h2]I am thrilled to announce that Nienix will exit Early Access in less than two months! [/h2]

The features that were originally planned for Early Access were extended quite a bit based on community feedback (and there is still time left... :-)). I'm very grateful to all of you for contributing - both Nienix and the dev process would have been way less fun without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c7d16860c5d44773c4cec2292ec18cfbfe461d68.gif[/img]

Being out of Early Access does [i]not[/i] mean that the development of the game will stop. It simply means that the features that I indented for Early Access have been accomplished. I plan to add new content for many more years to come. A few things that come to mind are:

🎯 New items, item mods, item sets and skills.
🎯 New end-game challenges.
🎯 Changes to current content based on player feedback.
🎯 Making modding easier by giving everyone access to the world editors.

[h3] 17th of February 2023: 15 USD -> 20 USD[/h3]
As is described on the store page, the price of the game will be increased when the game exits Early Access. More specifically, the price will be increased from 15 USD to 20 USD. The new recommended Steam pricing tool will also be employed, which will further adjust the price for some currencies. The price increase will be made on the 17th of February 2023. The change is made a month prior to release as there is a 1 month sales cooldown on Steam after adjusting the price - there will be a sale starting on the release day.

[h2]On another note, there have been a bunch of additions since the last announcement. In particular:[/h2]

[h3]Continuum Challenges[/h3]
🎯 Continuum Challenges are end-game challenges that when accomplished provide fixed player buffs such as bonus skill points. If you die during a challenge, you need to restart it (dissimilar to Continuum Events). Unlock them by completing a Continuum Event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/ab93708d31b897ad29210be7dd5f8e9240e24b17.gif[/img]

[h3]Quality-of-life[/h3]
🎯 Many user interfaces have been revised. For example, a text search field has been added to the Continuum Transmuter and items are enlarged when highlighted in the inventory.
🎯 Most enemies now have random weapon cooldowns when they spawn. This change was made to create more dynamic engagements.
🎯 Performance has been significantly increased when there are lots of bullets active.
🎯 Systems related to multiplayer have been reworked. Playing multiplayer should now be a lot more stable and smooth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/80731413f851017bd8917f30179c2dd0cdc86e4b.png[/img]

[h3]Skills[/h3]
🎯 The Xinthu tier 7 skill Experimental Catalyst has been added. If a weapon provides damage over time, its direct damage and hull repair are converted to damage over time. Attack speed is reduced by 80%.
🎯 The Imperius skill "Halt!" has been revised. It now works as follows: Enemies hit by your fixed-point Frost weapons have {0}% chance to receive reduced resistance to all elements by {1}% for {2} seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e77d9fcd5542ae684cd330f38889cedf9f148cac.png[/img]

Thanks for reading, and for supporting the development of Nienix!

/Hannes

notes.title: A new Xinthu skill!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.630[/h3]
🎯 [New skill] The Xinthu tier 7 skill Experimental Catalyst has been added. If a weapon provides damage over time, its direct damage and hull repair are converted to damage over time. Attack speed is reduced by 80%.
🎯 [Balance] The "Brute Edition" weapon mod can no longer be used on purely auxiliary weapons that have 0 DPS.
🎯 [UI] Current player conditions in the UI are now sorted according to type and effectiveness.
🎯 [Misc] The setting "Networking_Max_MTU" has been added (this setting is not possible to change from within the game). Per default, the max MTU for network packets is automatically identified by the game itself. However, some users seem to have had issues with this function. A too high MTU can cause various weird behavior when playing multiplayer, such as lag and infinite loading screens. If you experience such events when playing multiplayer, try setting Networking_Max_MTU to 1200. I.e., add <Networking_Max_MTU>1200</Networking_Max_MTU> to ../game_root/Data/config.cfg.
🎯 [Performance] Greatly increased performance when playing with builds that produce lots of bullets.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to changing skins for Sentinel-type ships.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to using follow-type weapons on fixed weapon points when using Sentinel-type ships.

notes.title: Christmas update that includes Act 4!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas!

Today's patch brings a plethora of new features to the main branch:

[h2]Act 4[/h2]
🎯 Act 4 can now be explored by all players! This act includes 60 new enemies and four campaign bosses. 
🎯 If you have unlocked Continuum Mode previous to this patch, Continuum Mode will be locked. Don't panic: all your progress, unlocked waypoints and such from playing Continuum Mode are still there. However, you need to finish Act 4 first to enter Continuum Mode. At that point, Continuum Mode will be unlocked and your previous progress during Continuum Mode made available.
🎯 To enter Act 4, complete the final mission in Act 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c05c54d980da360a181334549df521e1803f222b.gif[/img]

[h2]Level cap increased to 60[/h2]
🎯 You can now level up to 60!

[h2]Continuum XL[/h2]
🎯 Continuum XL brings various changes to the core game experience and is unlocked by completing Act 4 on Continuum Mode. 

[h2]Grand and Uber Continuum Events[/h2]
🎯 Grand and Uber Continuum Events have now been added to the game. These events are end-game dungeons with special loot available in Continuum XL.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3df5c4afeaa63f3e55eb52a3bfe058cc3b3bc670.gif[/img]

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 [i]Item sets[/i]: 16 item sets have been added! These can drop for Mythic and higher item grades. Their drop rate is significantly increased during Continuum XL, especially towards the end, as well as in Continuum Events (based on their difficulty).
🎯 [i]Uber-grade items[/i]: These items that only are dropped in Grand and Uber Continuum Events.
🎯 [i]Stationary Indestructible Hull[/i]: An Active Auxiliary Item that generates an aura which provides temporary invulnerability to all allies within its range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/0f8f83ddcce141c7b090d497d4c6edbc83e6555d.png[/img]

[h2]New skills[/h2]
🎯 [i]Flux Deflector[/i] (Founders Tier 3): Damage taken from a single hit can at most inflict X% of your max hull. Your hull regeneration is reduced by Y%.
🎯 [i]Hardened Tail[/i] (Axiom Tier 2): Direct damage to Sentinel tail segments is reduced by X%-Y%, where damage reduction is higher for segments further away from the head. 
🎯 [i]Emergency Repairs[/i] (Founders Tier 2): The player is instantly brought back to life with X% hull upon suffering fatal damage, and is then invulnerable for Y seconds. Has a cooldown of Z minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/03ca7ce4dafc72b549b24b529f4c00b245375480.png[/img]

[h2]Quality-of-life updates[/h2]
🎯 Enable/disable bullet on-hit effects: You can now enable or disable bullet on-hit-effects for different sources. 
🎯 The map UI has been revised to make navigation easier.
🎯 Many sprites have been polished.
🎯 You can now choose which map modes that are enabled. This setting is located under the General settings section (the option "Enabled map modes"). The default setting is "All"
🎯 Simplified Chinese is now supported! This localization was single-handedly done by 执天之意(WH)! If you have a Chinese language set in your operating system, it should automatically change the language to simplified Chinese the first time the game is started post this patch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/324d4d158fe9df3086f25125424dd83cbbb51275.png[/img]

Other news: while more content and changes are planned for early access, Nienix is on track for a Q1 2023 release. 

Hope to see you all in game!

/Hannes

notes.title: Grand Continuum Events and Act 4 open beta!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.55509206[/h3]
🎯 [Grand  Continuum Events] Grand Continuum Events have now been added to the game. These events are available in Continuum XL.
🎯 [Sound effects] It is now possible to toggle enemy death sounds (default:on). This setting is located in the Audio section of the main menu options.
🎯 [Balance] Reduced the aggro modifier of enemy summons.
🎯 [Balance] The damage of the background fire trap has been reduced by 50%.
🎯 [Misc] Set items affixes are no longer removed when fragments that re-roll item properties are used.
🎯 [Misc] The Act 4 test branch has been unlocked for anyone to try. To play the open beta, do the following:

[olist]
[*] Right-click the Nienix icon in your Steam library
[*] Click "Properties"
[*] Click "BETAS"
[*] Select "beta - Test branch"
[*] Have fun playing!
[/olist]
Before you enable the Act 4 test build, make sure to backup your save game folder (<NienixRoot>/Data/Save/). When you have passed level 40 with a character, the corresponding save wont be applicable to the regular build anymore.  

The Act 4 test branch contains the following updates:
[list]
[*] You can explore Act 4. This act includes 60 new enemies and four campaign bosses.
[*] You can level up to 60.
[*] You can unlock (and complete) the Continuum XL mode, which contains various changes to the core game experience.
[*] As a bonus, a completely new game mode called "Fleet Commander" is included. This mode lets you battle an AI or friend in an RTS-like auto-battler. I'm unsure if this game mode will make it into the final release. Please let me know what you think!
[/list]
 When you begin playing the Act 4 build, the Continuum Mode will be locked. Don't panic: all your progress, unlocked waypoints and such are still there. However, you need to finish Act 4 first. At that point, Continuum Mode will be unlocked and your progress during Continuum Mode made available.

To enter Act 4, complete the final mission in Act 3.

notes.title: Eight month recap!
notes.content:
It's now been eight months since Early Access started!

The major news is that Act 4 almost is completed! A closed alpha that includes both Act 4 and Continuum XL difficulty will begin in about a week and run for a month. If you wish to participate in the alpha, let me know on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dmsq2Sq]Discord[/url]!

Apart from working on Act 4, tons of new features have been added during the three months since the last major news update. Most of these changes were made based on player feedback on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dmsq2Sq]Discord[/url]. Please let me know if there is anything that you would like to see changed! It has a good chance to make it into the game.

[h2]Sentinel ships[/h2]
🎯 A completely new ship type has been added! This variant moves like the worm summons, and is called "Sentinel". It comes with on-board turrets and can be modded in the same fashion as other ships.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3bdafae9065ea4a2b2f03512371bdf1961b39bc1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/fb6cdba4df28c9f06925d0e6ef2f8edfe433537f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/42c2c903e4c206e3e0a15a81109f8bfd997bffae.gif[/img]

[h2]Loot recycler[/h2]
🎯 A new "loot recycling" feature has been added. The loot filter in the main menu now reads/works as follows: The minimum item quality to display in world space. If using the Bulk or Collision loot pickup options, this is also the minimum quality that is picked up. Loot that is skipped due to the loot filter is recycled. Every 100 recycled items yields a new item. The quality of this item depend on the quality of the recycled items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/2c9fdedb0c4b57d30e085a0a67229403fe3c8da2.png[/img]

[h2]Dedicated server[/h2]
🎯 A dedicated server that can be run in headless (console) mode has been added. It is available for all platforms, including the demo. It is an executable called "NienixDedicatedServer" in the game root directory. Apart from the obvious use-case when playing PvP, the dedicated server also enables playing the PvE campaign in a "persistent world" that is not reset (unless you kill the server).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/1fea0faf5288c2ad1f7c780a77a7ddfe88a14d38.png[/img]

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 Five new Xinthu Frigate-class ships have been added to the loot table. They are between 100 and 350 meters in diameter. Most of these are unlocked in the loot table from Act 2 onwards.
🎯 11 Sentinel-type ships have been added to the loot table.
🎯 Targeting System (RT): Sets the target of summons based on the position of the crosshair. Provides a bonus to resistance. 
🎯 Targeting System (DT): Sets the target of summons based on the position of the crosshair. Provides a bonus to damage.

[h2]New item modifications[/h2]
🎯 Glass Cannon Edition: Increased attack speed at the cost of reduced resist all.
🎯 Bruiser Edition: Increased damage and aura effectiveness at the cost of reduced attack speed.

[h2]New skills[/h2]
🎯 Wormhole Mastery IV (Founders): When an active auxiliary item is activated, the cooldown of any equipped Warp Field Generator is reset.
🎯 Crit Booster (Founders): Chance of critical hits is increased by X%. Crit damage is increased by Y%. This also applies to on-board turrets.
🎯 Featherweight (Axiom): Reduces the total player weight.
🎯 Defiant Shields (Imperius): Increases drone resistance to all elements.
🎯 Robust Core (Xinthu): Increases drone hull.
🎯 Tough Shell (Xinthu): Increases drone resistance to all elements.

[h2]Quality-of-life updates[/h2]
🎯 It is now possible to enable highlighting (either red or white) to all enemies. This setting is available in the User interface section of the main menu options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/bf7010bf8319b9f36c6a7d36b04ff2d99e31626b.gif[/img]
🎯 If the "Highlight Items" key is pressed (default binding: left alt), objects that currently can be interacted with (e.g., doors or station platforms) are now given an outline in world space. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/47653820d00b0cfca314a70025f4dda595ad878b.gif[/img]
🎯 You can now enable auto-cast for all relevant item slots (engine, active auxiliary items and weapons). See the check boxes in the inventory screen. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3fa19611abc7285ff0d24482f13a448b5ff64489.png[/img]
🎯 Modding and demodding items no longer rerolls their stats. 
🎯 All larger ships have now been given a default % bonus to hull regeneration (as it pretty much was a per-requisite to use bigger ships). It works similar to the Axiom skill "Heavy Plating", but with Sentinel-type ships getting a bonus based on the length of the tail.
🎯 When playing COOP, the last known position of a player in a dungeon or open world space is now shown in the map and HUD.
🎯 Various dungeons have been enlarged to enable being traversed with larger ships.
🎯 It is now possible to lock the crosshair in front of the ship when using mouse + keyboard. This setting is called "Mouse aim" and located in the control scheme section of the main menu
🎯 You can now set friendly fire to "None" (henceforth the default value).
🎯 You can now change the color of the laser sight. This option is located in the user interface section of the main menu options.
🎯 You can now disarm the alternative ship slot entirely, enabling builds that have the same ship but different auxiliary items.
🎯 The speed of all summons has been increased.

Thanks for supporting the development of Nienix! 

/Hannes

notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.5550920380[/h3]

notes.title: Founders skill updates and stackable sensors!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.5550920373[/h3]
🎯 [UI] An option to scale general text depending on camera zoom has been added. It is called "UI Scaling: General text" and is available in the user interface options section.
🎯 [UI] The font scale of consumables are now adjusted depending on the value of "UI Scaling: Item names".
🎯 [Skill] A new Founders skill has been added: "Wormhole Mastery IV" - When an active auxiliary item is activated, the cooldown of any equipped Warp Field Generator is reset.
🎯 [Skill] The Founders skill "Engine Booster" has been replaced by "Crit Booster": Chance of critical hits is increased by X%. Crit damage is increased by Y%. This also applies to on-board turrets.
🎯 [Skill] The Founders skill "Stabilized Molten Metals" has been revised. It now works as follows: Bullet velocity and range are increased by X% per Metre of sensor range. This also applies to on-board ship turrets.
🎯 [Misc] It is now possible to stack sensors (albeit with a dimishing return).
🎯 [Misc] Pressing the on-screen map button now always brings up the full-screen map.
🎯 [Misc] The MTU is now automatically identified by both server and client. This should alleviate network issues for machines that cannot handle an MTU of 1500.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders skill "Mortal Strike" and "Lucky strike", and the Axiom skill "Aim Mastery" now also apply to on-board turrets.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders skill "Lucky Strike" now provides 3% bonus crit per level (down from 5%).
🎯 [Balance] The Founders skill "Sensor Amplifier" has been updated: Sensor range is extended by the range of a Standard Sensor equal to player level. It is then extended by an additional X%. In short, this means that spending a point in this skill is similar to equipping a Sensor.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders Talent "Ignited Warp Plasma" now provides a base buff to explosion radius of all weapons of 100 (up from 40).
🎯 [Balance] The "Drone Hull Module" now provides less % bonus to hull.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause multiplayer games not to be joinable after exiting a game session.

notes.title: New weapon mods and balance adjustments
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.5550920370[/h3]
🎯 [New Weapon mod] Glass Cannon Edition: Increased attack speed at the cost of reduced resist all.
🎯 [New Weapon mod] Bruiser Edition: Increased damage and aura effectiveness at the cost of reduced attack speed.
🎯 [Balance] The two new weapon mods described above can roll for all auxiliary weapon types.
🎯 [Balance] The warp plasma requirement of follow-type auras on auxiliary items has been increased by 20%.
🎯 [Balance] The Axiom skill "Heavy Plating" now provides a diminishing return past 360% (600 metres).
🎯 [Balance] The likelihood of stun provided by the weapon mod "Stun Edition" is now based on weapon attack speed and its number of bullets per shot.
🎯 [Balance] The Xinthu skill "Slow But Deadly" (5:4) now provides 10% decreased attack speed and 15% increased damage per level.
🎯 [Balance] Hull repair provided by weapons is now affected by item grade (a higher grade/rarity means a stronger hull repair).
🎯 [Balance] The Corrosive Bomb weapon is now allowed on ship turrets.
🎯 [Balance] All auxiliary-type weapons are now allowed on ship turrets.
🎯 [Balance] Weapons that provide hull repair on collision can now heal self given that they have sufficient explosion radius. This means that most Xinthu-type weapons, given that their bullet explode, now repair self. Previously, weapons would only repair self if they created hull repair auras on termination.
🎯 [Bug fix] Doors now correctly requires defeating the boss enemies to be opened in one of the open-world type Continuum Events.

notes.title: Five month recap!
notes.content:
It's now been five months since Early Access started!

Most work during the past two months has concerned Act 4, but a fair few changes have been made to the public build as well. As always: For a complete list of changes, [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dmsq2Sq]Join Discord[/url] or look at the news section in Steam. Thanks for supporting the development of Nienix!

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 12 new Vagrantis-type ships have been added to the loot table.
🎯 Drone Tug Engine: All summoned drones of equal or lower level as this engine are pulled to the ship when it is boosting.
🎯 B-Missile: A Vagrantis weapon that fires large gyro-stabilized missiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f03dfb384a0df2afdb3cfb9ababc7038f0fb787d.gif[/img]

[h2]Gambler updates[/h2]
🎯 There is now a sort option in the gambler.
🎯 The loot filter now works in the gambler as well (for text matching item names).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/be3f02a81c76464f6376adc402e1ff1d150a648a.png[/img]

[h2]Continuum Transmuter updates[/h2]
🎯 The titles and descriptions of all possible item recipes in the Continuum Transmuter are now presented. Only discovered recipes contain information regarding their requirements.
🎯 It is now possible to spend Latinum to research unknown recipes.
🎯 Two new recipes related to Continuum Events have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/afd3d170310b1529d0cf9e866bccf87f4c172dc0.png[/img]

[h2]Storage updates[/h2]
There are now several new tab filter options in the storage (item grade, item type and a free text field).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/cbc1e1961d64dab89b3979001f9503c3daa22ea8.png[/img]

[h2]Quality-of-life updates[/h2]
🎯 The width of crosshair lasers can now be adjusted. See "Crosshair Laser Width (%)" in main menu -> options -> user interface.
🎯 How crosshair lasers scale based on world-space camera zoom is now adjustable. See "UI Scaling: Lasers" in main menu -> options -> user interface.
🎯 It is now possible to lock the cursor to the game window. This option is located in the general options section of the main menu ("Lock cursor to window").
🎯 A confirmation modal is now presented if the exit game button is pressed while a game session is active.
🎯 The main menu now contains a "Continue" button if a game session is active when the main menu is enabled.
🎯 The main menu now contains a "Solo campaign" button which starts a single player campaign game with the difficulty set in the standard create game screen. 
🎯 Ship class and diameter are now presented in tooltips for unidentified items (e.g., in the gambler).
🎯 Content preloading can now be toggled on/off (default:on). If off, content is dynamically loaded when required. This results in quicker game loading time and lower RAM usage at the cost of occasional lag when new content is being loaded. Machines with low or shared video memory may benefit from disabling this setting. It is available in the general options menu.
🎯 Another gamepad control scheme has been added.
🎯 The 'Bulk' loot pickup method now expands based on the player sensor range.
🎯 Player interaction is now based on the location of the cursor instead of the position of the ship.
🎯 Weapon range is now presented in item tooltips. A few weapons (most notably, the Frost Tornado) are not fully supported by this subsystem yet - but will be soon. Item tooltips for drone summoning items will receive this statistic at a later date.

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
🎯 Several Vagrantis weapons are now gyro-stabilized (bullets are fired as though the firing ship is at rest).
🎯 Axiom weapons have been made more powerful.

notes.content:

notes.title: Third month recap!
notes.content:
It's now been three months since Early Access started! A summary of the most significant changes during the third month are presented below. 

Many of the changes are based on player feedback. [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dmsq2Sq]Join Discord[/url] if you want to shape the development of Nienix!

[h2]On-board ship turret inventory[/h2]
Each individual on-board ship turret can now be customized! The turret employs its equipped weapon, including all passive and active bonuses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f8fb56af056ac1abbcf6c3d740a173f3c3024be1.gif[/img]

[h2]Global bonuses for summoned drones and on-board ship turrets[/h2]
Summoned drones and on-board ship turrets can now be buffed by passive bonuses. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/d756e2571caebff6a3388565c9670883387089c3.gif[/img]

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 [i]Guided Destroyer[/i]: a Vagrantis weapon that shoots heavy homing rockets with large area of effect.
🎯 [i]Fighter Hangars[/i]: Eight new Fighter Hangars have been added.
🎯 [i]Xinthu Brain[/i]: A new Xinthu Battleship with six turret slots.
🎯 [i]Purger[/i]: an active auxiliary item that removes up to three random debuffs to all friendlies in an area around the caster.
🎯 [i]Drone Damage Multiplier[/i]: A passive auxiliary item that works the same as the Damage Multiplier, but for drones.
🎯 [i]Drone Resistance Multiplier[/i]: A passive auxiliary item that works the same as the Resistance Multiplier, but for drones.
🎯 [i]Drone Hull Module T-1[/i]: A passive auxiliary item that increases max hull of drones by a percentage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/349200e3290345023e716f75bb6337d33da0c7df.gif[/img]

[h2]New Continuum Fragments[/h2]
Three new Continuum Fragments have been added:
🎯 [i]To-1 Fragment[/i]: Allows converting all drone and ship turret bonuses to player bonuses on an item.
🎯 [i]To-2 Fragment[/i]: Allows converting all drone and player bonuses to ship turret bonuses on an item.
🎯 [i]To-3 Fragment[/i]: Allows converting all player and ship turret bonuses to drone bonuses on an item.

[h2]Misc other new features[/h2]
🎯 Mouse button 3, 4 and 5 can be bound to any key.
🎯 There are now four different variants of the world-space crosshair.
🎯 Two open-space type Continuum Events have been added. These should be well suited to big ships.
🎯 Upon player death, the suffered damage types as well as the biggest damage dealer is presented in the UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/39e7f00f3f6c7b3b4bedee19e868cd7eb61d1b7c.gif[/img]

[h2]Various bug fixes, polish and balancing[/h2]
Apart from new features, there's been loads of balancing and some polish made. For example:
🎯 A shader/graphical effect has been added for when swapping between ships.
🎯 Many menus and tooltips have been improved.
🎯 Most bonus % damage skills (a total of 12 revised skills) now also increase ship turret damage.
🎯 Font scaling has been improved to work well also on really small resolutions (e.g., the Steam Deck).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f52a752b5f71bc3bf9c904ac6ab531866ec27cb1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e443a4cbe7d72fca8251824c698de0c85e951113.gif[/img]

Thanks to everyone who has supported the development process by buying the game! And a special thanks to all those who have submitted their feedback!

/Hannes

notes.title: Fully customizable drones and ship turrets!
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.55509203[/h3]
🎯 [Drone Properties] Summoned drones can now be buffed by passive bonuses in the same way as players. Each item has a likelihood to roll properties that passively affect drones.
🎯 [Ship Turret Properties] On-board ship turrets can now be buffed by passive bonuses in the same way as players. Each item has a likelihood to roll properties that passively affect ship turrets.
🎯 [UI] Item tooltips now describe drone and ship turret passive buffs. These are included in their calculated DPS and Hull in tooltips.
🎯 [UI] The character stat sheet now also describes all drone and ship turret properties properties. Loot filter options are available as well.
🎯 [Weapon] A new Vagrantis weapon called "Guided Destroyer" has been added. It shoots heavy homing rockets with large area of effect.
🎯 [Passive Auxiliary Item] The Drone Damage Multiplier has been added. It works the same as the Damage Multiplier, but for drones and on-board turrets.
🎯 [Passive Auxiliary Item] The Drone Resistance Multiplier has been added. It works the same as the Resistance Multiplier, but for drones and on-board turrets.
🎯 [Passive Auxiliary Item] The Drone Hull Module T-1 has been added. It increases max hull of drones by a percentage.
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter] The "To-1 Fragment" has been added. It allow converting all drone and ship turret bonuses to player bonuses on an item.
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter] The "To-2 Fragment" has been added. It allow converting all drone and player bonuses to ship turret bonuses on an item.
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter] The "To-3 Fragment" has been added. It allow converting all player and ship turret bonuses to drone bonuses on an item.
🎯 [Balancing] The base crit multiplier value is now 10% (up from 0%).
🎯 [Balancing] The health of Deflector Domes summoned by the Deflector Dome Active Auxiliary item has been increased by 30%.
🎯 [Balancing] The damage of the Worm Hugger summon has been significantly increased.
🎯 [Balancing] Maximum negative resistance is now -100% (up from -500%). Maximum positive resistance is now 75% (down from 80%).
🎯 [Balancing] Drones now also get reduced resistance when playing on Continuum Mode.
🎯 [Balancing] The Xinthu talent "Drone Damage Mastery" [7:5] now provides a 80% bonus (up from 10%).  
🎯 [Balancing] Drones have 50% less hull and do 40% less damage. Drones at lower levels (< 8) are less affected by this nerf. This change was made to compensate for the fact that drones now have their own customizable properties.
🎯 [Balancing] Ship turrets do 30% less damage. Ships at lower levels (< 8) are less affected by this nerf. This change was made to compensate for the fact that ship turrets now have their own customizeable properties.
🎯 [Balancing] Two Vagrantis Homing-type weapons have been disabled from use as ship turrets.
🎯 [Misc] There Hammerhead-type bosses in the "Void Space A-2" Continuum Event have been replaced by Battleship-type bosses.
🎯 [Misc] Weapon feedback has been reduced.
🎯 [Misc] NPCs in rescue NPC-events have increased hull.
🎯 [Bug fix] There was a possible race condition in the player saving/loading system, which could cause incorrectly loaded inventories if starting a new game quickly after closing one. This is now fixed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue regarding a skill that was incorrectly reset.

notes.title: Second month recap!
notes.content:
It's now been two months since Early Access started!

This second month has brought a plethora of new features, polish and balancing. As for the previous recaps, most of these features are based on community suggestions. Please provide suggestions on the Steam forum or [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dmsq2Sq]Discord[/url] if there is something you would like to see in Nienix!

[h2]Quick-swapping engine and auxiliary items[/h2]
Quick-swapping ship now also swaps the engine and all auxiliary items. This should make it easier to play with two different builds (e.g., a fighter in one configuration and a cruiser in the other).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/9e71c76a4436cf6fe130c6c8bbee34723e94b3c3.gif[/img]

[h2]New items[/h2]
🎯 [i]Targeting System[/i]: An auxiliary weapon that when fired makes all active summons target a given position. In addition, it creates a huge speed boost area of effect.
🎯 [i]Hangars[/i]: Eight Fighter Hangars and four Frigate Hangars have been added. These have a requirement regarding ship size, and cannot be used with smaller ships. If you play with a large ship in end-game, you can summon a fleet with hundreds of fighters.
🎯 [i]Experimental Sensor[/i]: Provides lower sensor range than the standard sensor, but in return provides random bonuses.
🎯 [i]Frigates[/i]: Three new Frigate-class ships have been added (LTM Frigate P1-P3). These have a diameter between 100 and 150 meters.
🎯 [i]Cloner T-2 Generator[/i]: Summons a Cloner T-2 drone that is larger and stronger that the Cloner T-1 variant.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/0078267a91247452337404b6a0de07a0d25ab9c0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/8ec9884f1bef6bc5485ff9a718e3cab64f3267fe.gif[/img]

[h2]New Continuum Entities[/h2]
Three new Continuum Entities have been added:
🎯 [i]Sp-4 Fragment[/i]: Provides a specific modification to a given engine.
🎯 [i]Mp-4 Fragment[/i]: Provides a random modification to a given engine.
🎯 [i]Dye Fragment[/i]: Allows repainting a ship in a given color. Custom colors can be made by mixing dyes.

[h2]Engine mods[/h2]
Seven engine modifiers have been added. The mod extraction recipe works for these mods as well.
🎯 [i]Glass Cannon[/i]: Increased attack speed at the cost of reduced resist all.
🎯 [i]Heavy Shots[/i]: Increased damage at the cost of reduced attack speed.
🎯 [i]Sturdy Hull[/i]: Increased hull at the cost of reduced damage.
🎯 [i]Crit Mastery[/i]: Increased chance and damage of critical hits at the cost of reduced resistances. 
🎯 [i]Recovery Mode[/i]: Increased hull regeneration at the cost of reduced resistances. 
🎯 [i]Slow and Deadly[/i]: Increased damage at the cost of reduced boost velocity.
🎯 [i]Tough Cookie[/i]: Increased resistances at the cost of reduced attack speed.

[h2]New features for the Storage[/h2]
🎯 Filters that make it possible to bulk-move different items to different storage tabs have been added.
🎯 The available space in the storage has been significantly increased (by a factor of 6x).
🎯 It is now possible to bulk-move items between the storage and the inventory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/6c2843177da93293f0c331e8cc2e61a7c898e0e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/175d5563c1215904450abf0fa332e15f5f1ba7d0.gif[/img]

[h2]Misc other new features[/h2]
🎯 The number of recipes that remain to be discovered is now presented in the UI.
🎯 All main quest dungeons have been enlarged to make the experience when playing with larger ships more enjoyable. Several new dungeons and caves have also been added.
🎯 It is now possible to set how hull bars, cooldown bars and item names should scale along with camera zoom. These options are presented in the general options section in the main menu. The default setting is 40%.
🎯 Passive drones (e.g., Cloner T-1 drones) can now drop in variants that make them fixed at the side, front or back of the ship.
🎯 The Xinthu skill "Turbo Drones" [2:3] has been added. This skill increases the speed of all drones with up to 300%.

[h2]Various bug fixes, polish (UI and sound effects) and balancing[/h2]
Apart from new features, there's been loads of balancing and some polish made. For example:
🎯 Many sound effects have been revised and five new sound effects have been added.
🎯 Many particle effects have been polished.
🎯 Enemy damage has been increased on overall.
🎯 The shared hull when swapping ships is now set base on percent from max hull (rather than as an absolute value). For example, if switching from a full-health fighter to a cruiser, the cruiser will also have full health.

Now, back to working on Act 4!

/Hannes

notes.title: First month recap!
notes.content:
It's now been one month since Early Access started!

This month has brought a ton of new features. As for the previous recap, most of these features are based on community suggestions. Please join discord if there is something you would like to see in Nienix - theres a good chance that it will happen.

[h2]First week[/h2]
The first week added, among other things, a loot filter, a skill toggle, and two new loot pickup methods. This is covered by the previous post. The remainder of this post describes features introduced during week 2-4.

[h2]Hardcore mode[/h2]
A Hardcore mode has been added. If a character playing on Hardcore dies in the campaign, it is moved to the Softcore campaign. Characters that play on Hardcore have their own shared Storage. Coop play is possible between Hardcore and Softcore. Playing on Hardcore enables unlocking a bunch of new achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/1ac270f2c4031c5bb690ea8f0f15096e7fe558a6.png[/img]

[h2]Giant stations[/h2]
The game engine has been reworked to handle gigantic stations that can be easily traversed even with the largest Dreadnaughts. So far, a few new such stations have been added and some existing stations have been enlarged. Many more are in development!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f8c2a1ec6837165c86a47db16b0caf33be8540ae.gif[/img]

[h2]Major revisions to the map[/h2]
The map can now display sectors even when their content has been unloaded from memory! This works by caching sector map graphics, and in short means that discovered events can be viewed regardless of their distance from the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/adecf246fb43a152b67ab3e5fe294776891dd340.gif[/img]

[h2]Quick-swapping ship[/h2]
It is now possible to quick-swap the ship using a key. This is especially powerful in combination with the Axiom skill "[i]Quick-Swap[/i]", that enables switching ship even when enemies are near.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/58b106ba47c3bdf2601b7161dc0b8d297e8cb032.gif[/img]

[h2]Increased sensor range[/h2]
The game can now handle even greater sensor range (~7300, up from ~4000). This should improve the experience when playing with Dreadnaught-class ships.

[h2]New skills[/h2]
Three new skills have been added:
🎯 The Axiom skill "[i]Heavy Plating[/i]" [1:4] increases Hull regeneration based on the size of the ship (at max level with a big ship, it gives a 800% boost). It should make life easier when playing with larger ship types.
🎯 The Founders skill "[i]Reinforced Plating[/i]" [1:1] increases the total hull by 2% per level.
🎯 The Founders skill "[i]Enhanced Damage[/i]" [2:3] increases damage by 2% per level. 

In addition, the focused skill can now be toggled using a hotkey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/57db446995259609e85c0ffa1dac9cd4473357bf.png[/img]

[h2]New Continuum Fragments[/h2]
Three new Continuum Fragments have been added:
🎯 The [i]Sp-1 Fragment[/i] provides a specific modification to a given auxiliary item.
🎯 The [i]Sp-2 Fragment[/i] provides a specific modification to a given weapon or drone summoner auxiliary item.
🎯 The [i]Sp-3 Fragment[/i] provides a specific modification to a given ship.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b494521a75734a6a0c5f4501645cd56f73aa0ca8.png[/img]

[h2]Misc other changes[/h2]
🎯 The loot filter is now considered when sorting items.
🎯 A text input has been added to the loot filter.
🎯 Two new item-based recipes has been added to the Continuum Transmuter.
🎯 Continuum Fragments that provide item modifications now only re-rolls item properties if the item already has a modification.
🎯 The experience with large ships have been improved by various changes, such as increasing the damage output of their on-board turrets. Switching ship now also requires less surrounding space.
🎯 The second act has undergone major changes to make it a better experience.

[h2]Various bug fixes, polish (UI and sound effects) and balancing[/h2]
Apart from fun new features, many minor issues have been improved based on community feedback.

[h2]Future updates[/h2]
Progress is made on many things, both large and small! You can expect polish (e.g. regarding sound effects), new quality-of-life-features, more giant stations and various balance adjustments. Most importantly though, I am hard at work creating new content for the fourth act.

notes.title: Launch week summary!
notes.content:
It's now been one week since Early Access started!

A big thanks to everyone who has played so far, you rock! And a special thanks to those that have given their feedback! Several great new features have already been added based on the feedback from the community - many more will be added in the coming weeks!

[h2]Loot filters[/h2]
It is now possible to set different loot filters to highlight items with properties valuable to your build!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f0dc487cabeef578be0d547045077b6c094f667d.gif[/img]

[h2]Disabling skills[/h2]
Any unlocked skill can now be enabled/disabled!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/33adc784cbe14b56d925a9aa46766bf5af19d3e0.png[/img]

[h2]New loot pickup methods[/h2]
There are now three different loot pickup methods available:
🎯 [i]Standard[/i]: Pressing the interact button causes the loot closest to the player to be picked up. (This is the default variant)
🎯 [i]Collision[/i]: All loot is picked up automatically upon collision with the player.
🎯 [i]Bulk[/i]: Pressing the interact button causes all items in a large area around the player to be picked up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/2f5e86a91db1c6333b7842a2948ea184b22c480d.gif[/img]

[h2]New recipes in the Continuum Transmuter[/h2]
Three new item modifications have been added:
🎯 Glass cannon: Increased attack speed at the cost of reduced resist all.
🎯 Heavy shooter: Increased damage at the cost of reduced attack speed.
🎯 Sturdy Hull: Increased hull at the cost of reduced damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/94d7541cd2c3196616c20395ed952e3cc3748631.gif[/img]

[h2]Various bug fixes, polish (UI and sound effects) and balancing[/h2]
Apart from fun new features, many minor issues have been improved based on community feedback.

notes.title: Heavy Gunships Update!
notes.content:
The demo and beta tester build have been updated!

This update contains a range of new features:
[list]
[*] Frigates, cruisers and motherships have been added to the loot tables. These are heavier than light gunships. To compensate, they have more hull and are equipped with turrets. 
[*] There is now a "Flight Assist" option that if enabled causes the ship to slowly stop if the player is not attempting to move.
[*] Various bugs have been patched. Example fixed bugs include corrections to AI pathfinding and AOE colliders, and a bug related to screen resolutions for multi-monitor setups.
[*] Several significant performance increases have been made.
[/list]
